executive_summary: REQUIRE-X Multi-Agent AI Framework evaluated the Software Requirement Specification 'ecommerce_srs.txt'. The specification comprises 11 total requirements (5 Functional, 6 Non-Functional) with an estimated agile effort of 43 story points. The document attained an ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 compliance score of 92.5% (Grade: A). The framework generated 16 automated test cases, achieving 100.0% bidirectional traceability coverage mapped to a recommended Event-Driven Microservices Architecture blueprint.
key_strengths: Clear structural separation of 5 Functional Requirements across core system modules.
High traceability readiness (100.0% of requirements directly mapped to automated test suites).
Standardized numbering scheme compliant with ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 standards.
key_risks: Identified 2 ambiguous or unquantified statements (18.2% defect rate) that introduce misinterpretation risks.
action_items: Review and approve the suggested disambiguated rewrites in the Ambiguity Audit tab.
Adopt the recommended Event-Driven Microservices Architecture component decomposition for architecture design.
Export the generated Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) and Test Suite into the project's QA management tool.

ambiguities.explanation: 'Seamless' is a marketing buzzword. Detail exact API integration protocols and error mitigation.
ambiguities.suggested_rewrite: The application should be using authenticated RESTful JSON APIs with automatic token refresh and work efficiently across web and mobile browsers.

ambiguities.explanation: Passive construct 'be hashed' obscures the system actor responsible for the action.
ambiguities.suggested_rewrite: The System shall explicitly execute the action rather than stating 'be hashed'.

dependencies.description: Performance latency SLA (FR-006) constrains runtime throughput of 'Enable registered consumers to browse product'.
Execution of 'Manage persistent digital shopping carts with' requires prior user authentication (NFR-002).
Execution of 'Notify customers via automated email and' requires prior user authentication (NFR-002).
Notification event 'Notify customers via automated email and' is triggered by completion of 'Notify customers via automated email and'.

criteria.remediation: Ensure all edge cases, exceptions, and security guardrails are fully specified.

strengths: No mutually exclusive system states detected
criteria.remediation: Maintain a centralized data dictionary to avoid conflicting entity definitions.

defects_found: NFR-002: Passive Voice / Missing Actor ('be hashed')
criteria.remediation: Apply suggested rewrites to eliminate subjective qualifiers and quantify all performance bounds.

strengths: Every requirement maps to acceptance test conditions
criteria.remediation: Define numerical acceptance metrics (e.g. latency in ms, uptime %).
Keep requirements isolated to minimize cross-cutting modification side-effects.

strengths: Explicit unique IDs for all items
Bidirectional linkage to architecture and test cases
criteria.remediation: Integrate IDs with Jira/ALM tools for end-to-end forward traceability.

strengths: Leverages established architectural design patterns and commercial off-the-shelf standards
criteria.remediation: Conduct technical spike tests on high-complexity modules.

strengths: Aligns with software domain standards and expected system behaviors
criteria.remediation: Review with stakeholders during formal SRS walkthrough.

strengths: Directly contributes to primary mission capabilities

compliance_scorecard.summary: The Software Requirement Specification achieved an overall ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 compliance score of 92.5% (A). Identified 11 requirements (5 FR, 6 NFR) with 2 quality defects requiring disambiguation to ensure full contractual and verification readiness.

architecture.rationale: Selected Event-Driven Microservices architecture due to demanding non-functional requirements in Scalability, high throughput, and independent domain decoupling. Asynchronous messaging isolates failure domains and supports horizontal elastic autoscaling.
tradeoffs_pros: High horizontal scalability and fault isolation
Independent deployment lifecycles per domain service
tradeoffs_cons: Higher distributed tracing and operational complexity
Eventual consistency data management across services

components.name: API Gateway & Security Provider
components.responsibility: Handles TLS termination, routing, JWT token verification, rate limiting, and CORS.

components.name: Core Business Logic Engine
components.responsibility: Executes primary application workflows, business validation, and entity state transitions.

components.name: Data Management & Persistence Service
components.responsibility: Manages relational schemas, transaction integrity, indexing, and backup persistence.

components.name: Telemetry, Monitoring & Quality Guard
components.responsibility: Collects performance metrics, audit logs, error traces, and health status.

architecture.mermaid_diagram:
graph TD
    Client["Client Apps (Web / Mobile)"] --> Gateway["API Gateway (Auth & Rate Limit)"]
    Gateway --> ServiceA["Auth & Identity Service"]
    Gateway --> ServiceB["Core Business Engine Service"]
    Gateway --> ServiceC["Processing & Transaction Service"]
    Gateway --> ServiceD["Analytics & Reporting Service"]
    
    ServiceB <--> EventBus[("Event Bus (Kafka / RabbitMQ)")]
    ServiceC <--> EventBus
    ServiceD <--> EventBus
    
    ServiceA --> DB_Auth[("Auth Database")]
    ServiceB --> DB_Core[("Core DB (PostgreSQL)")]
    ServiceC --> DB_Trans[("Tx Store")]
    ServiceD --> DB_Analytics[("Analytics Warehouse")]

test_cases.title: Verify Successful Execution of Enable registered consumers to browse product
test_cases.preconditions: System is active, database is connected, user has valid role permissions.
steps: 1. Navigate to the interface corresponding to 'Enable registered consumers to browse product'.
2. Supply valid operational input parameters.
3. Trigger action defined in 'The system shall enable registered consumers to browse product catalogs, filter by category/price, and perform full-text fuzzy searches.'.
4. Inspect system response and database state.
test_cases.test_data: Valid authorized user credentials & standard input payload.
test_cases.expected_result: System successfully executes Enable registered consumers to browse product with HTTP 200/201 status and persists expected state.

test_cases.title: Negative Validation & Boundary Check for Enable registered consumers to browse product
steps: 1. Trigger 'Enable registered consumers to browse product' with malformed, empty, or out-of-range input data.
2. Attempt action with expired authentication token or unauthorized role.
3. Inspect error telemetry and user feedback.
test_cases.test_data: Null strings, SQL metacharacters, oversized payloads, invalid types.
test_cases.expected_result: System safely rejects malformed input with user-friendly error message (HTTP 400/403/422) without crashing.
